create_OpsMixin_comparison_operators: create an OpsMixin subclass implementing comparison dunder methods like __eq__, __lt__, __le__, __gt__, __ge__ for array-like objects
create_OpsMixin_arithmetic_operators: create an OpsMixin subclass implementing arithmetic dunder methods like __add__, __sub__, __mul__, __truediv__ for array-like objects
create_OpsMixin_logical_operators: create an OpsMixin subclass implementing logical dunder methods like __and__, __or__, __xor__ for array-like objects
